# temps_project_group (Data Source)

Looks up a project group by `id` or `slug`, with the projects in it. Needs the `projects:read` permission.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "temps_project_group" "web" {
  slug = "web-apps"
}

output "web_project_ids" {
  value = data.temps_project_group.web.project_ids
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Numeric project group ID.
- `slug` (String) Project group slug.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description, null when none is set.
- `name` (String) Project group name.
- `project_ids` (Set of Number) IDs of the projects in the group.
